reference: Complete bibliographic citation and stable DOI or URL; do not leave a placeholder.
purpose: State the narrow measurement comparison being attempted, not a desired conclusion.
dynamics_match: Record temperature convention, isotropic coupling, lattice size, update rule and initial condition differences.
postprocessing_match: State whether the reference used one periodic 5-site majority pass and how this implementation differs, if at all.
observable_match: State precisely which chord/correlation/spectral quantities are comparable and which are not.
comparison_scope: Restrict the comparison to c=0.5 unless a reviewer gives a reasoned exception.
